popCulture.creator: Apollodorus
popCulture.description: Apollodorus' Asopid catalogue — Salamis as daughter of Asopus and mother of Cychreus, the naiad who gives her name to the island Ajax will later claim.

popCulture.title: Asopus
popCulture.description: The river-god's daughters name the map of Greece — Salamis among them, the island eponym beside Aegina, Thebe and Sinope.

popCulture.title: Salamis (mythology)
popCulture.description: Naiad daughter of Asopus — mother of Cychreus and eponym of the island that faces Attica across the strait.
